statement: Official Russian and Ukrainian delegations meet in person for a negotiating round between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-30, confirmed by both governments.
resolution: Russian (Kremlin or Foreign Ministry) and Ukrainian (Presidential Office or Foreign Ministry) officials each confirm their delegations met in person at a negotiating round held between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-30. Remote or intermediary-only exchanges do not count.
failure_condition: No in-person negotiating round between official Russian and Ukrainian delegations takes place between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-30.

statement: A Houthi missile or drone attack on Saudi territory kills at least one person between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22, confirmed by Saudi authorities.
resolution: The Saudi Press Agency or Saudi Ministry of Defense confirms at least one person killed on Saudi territory by a Houthi-launched missile or drone in an attack occurring between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22.
failure_condition: No Houthi missile or drone attack on Saudi territory between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22 kills anyone.

statement: The Israel Defense Forces or US Central Command acknowledges conducting a strike on a target inside Iranian territory between 2026-10-23 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: An official IDF or CENTCOM statement acknowledges an Israeli or US strike on a target inside Iranian territory carried out between 2026-10-23 and 2027-01-31. Strikes on Iranian-aligned forces outside Iran do not count.
failure_condition: Neither Israel nor the United States conducts an acknowledged strike on a target inside Iranian territory between 2026-10-23 and 2027-01-31.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle above 120.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-20. Reference: 111.58 on the packet date.
resolution: ICE Brent Crude futures front-month contract settles strictly above 120.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-20 inclusive, per ICE published settlement prices. Reference at seal: 111.58.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-20 is at or below 120.00 USD per barrel.

statement: CISA adds at least one PHP vulnerability from the October 2026 PHP2Shell disclosure to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with dateAdded between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-05.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry whose vendorProject or product field names PHP and whose dateAdded is between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-05 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming PHP carries a dateAdded between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-05 inclusive.

statement: CISA adds a GitLab vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with dateAdded between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-20.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry with vendorProject GitLab and dateAdded between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject GitLab carries a dateAdded between 2026-10-22 and 2026-11-20 inclusive.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of the 435 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election, as reflected in Associated Press race calls by 2026-12-04.
resolution: By 2026-12-04, Associated Press race calls show Democratic candidates winning at least 218 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election. Uncalled races count as not won.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates are called winners in fewer than 218 US House races as of 2026-12-04.

statement: The French government declares a state of emergency under the law of 3 April 1955 covering any part of metropolitan France by decree dated between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22.
resolution: A decree declaring a state of emergency under the law of 3 April 1955 covering any part of metropolitan France is published in the Journal officiel de la Republique francaise dated between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22.
failure_condition: No state-of-emergency decree under the 1955 law covering metropolitan France is issued between 2026-10-23 and 2026-11-22.

statement: Moderna announces between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31 that a Phase 3 trial of intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157), its individualized neoantigen cancer therapy, met its primary endpoint.
resolution: A Moderna press release dated between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31 reports top-line results from a Phase 3 trial of intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157) and states the trial met its primary endpoint. A miss, delay, or no release resolves false.
failure_condition: By 2026-12-31 Moderna has not announced a Phase 3 intismeran autogene trial meeting its primary endpoint, whether because results were negative or not yet released.

statement: The 2026-10-22 M7.0 earthquake near Nagqu, China (USGS us6000u43g) is followed by at least one M5.5 or greater aftershock within 100 km of its epicenter between 2026-10-22 15:04 UTC and 2026-11-06 00:00 UTC.
resolution: USGS ComCat lists an event other than us6000u43g with magnitude 5.5 or greater located within 100 km of its epicenter, origin time after 2026-10-22 15:04 UTC and before 2026-11-06 00:00 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 5.5 or greater occurs within 100 km of the us6000u43g epicenter between 2026-10-22 15:04 UTC and 2026-11-06 00:00 UTC.
